text:
Priya: Heads-up — EU ingest lag spiked at 03:12 UTC and kicked off a big recompute for hourly aggs. Priority lane quota is exhausted.
Marco: Which slice is this?
Priya: slice=eu-2026-03-20-03, mode=delta. It hit the 90% shard failure threshold and spilled to full-agg fallback.
Sam: Can you paste the quota alert?
Priya: Console alert: 
`[ALERT] backfill-allocator: tenant=tier-prod, lane=priority, available_slots=2, requested_slots=64`
Priya: backfill-bot posted: "allocated 0 of 64 due to tenant quota cap"
backfill-bot: Tenant quota cap reached; attempted fair-share fallback to standard lane.
Emily: We keep losing progress when a single slice trips full-agg. Can we add a mid-ground hedging option instead of stepping straight to full?
Marco: Current routing: try-priority -> fallback to standard -> if too many deltas, escalate to full. No intermediate retry behavior.
Sam: Proposal: add an API/console hedging toggle that attempts N small-slice retries in parallel across lanes with a temporary soft quota bump. Hedge=true on the start API.
Priya: Sketch of API: 
POST /api/v1/backfills
{ "slice_id": "eu-2026-03-20-03", "mode": "delta", "priority": "high", "hedge": true, "hedge_policy": "fractional:4" }
Marco: Concerns: soft quota => billing/chargeback implications; double-processing increases S3/compute. Need dedupe window on keys.
Emily: The prefix-KV cache can dedupe replays for ~60s per key — might cover hedged retries. Full-agg still tricky if we escalate.
Sam: UX: console checkbox "allow hedged retries (temporary extra cost)" with estimated cost delta and slider for multiplier 1x/2x/4x. Default off.
Priya: Add `cancel_if_committed: true` so hedged retries stop if a primary attempt succeeds.
Marco: Routing logic sketch: 1) attempt priority up to base slots; 2) if blocked and hedge=true, try fractional-slices across spare slots with temp soft-cap bump; 3) if majority succeed commit; else escalate to full-agg.
Sam: Need an abort leash and a fast API to cancel hedged retries. Also enforce max hedged retries per slice.
Priya: Agreed. Add `max_hedge_attempts=8`.
Emily: Telemetry from past dry-runs suggests early hedging can cut full-agg escalations ~35%. Worth a controlled pilot.
Marco: Data to surface in console: per-tenant hedged-run cost, success rate, latency delta, and slot-hours consumed.
Sam: Canary plan: enable hedging for tier-beta tenants for 24h and route 10% of priority backfills through it.
Priya: I'll open a canary ticket.
backfill-bot: Created canary ticket CB-712. Flag=eng-platform.hedge.beta=true.
Marco: Runbook additions: how to revoke soft cap, rollback hedging flag, billing dispute contact, and emergency kill-switch for hedged work.
Emily: Safety limits: max hedged retries N=8, max extra slot-hours per tenant/day.
Sam: I'll mock console UX and patch OpenAPI with the new hedging fields and a short e2e test.
Priya: For now I'm moving the current job to standard lane to stop SLA alerts. Monitoring this thread.
Marco: Follow-up checklist: API schema, console slider mock, billing calc, KV dedupe window, runbook blurb, canary ticket.
Sam: PR incoming with OpenAPI changes and integration test.
Emily: ✅
Priya: Tagging @oncall — latency stable for now.
backfill-bot: Canary ticket updated to in-progress.
